author_note: independent reference authored without access to the tool code; corrected and extended by two independent adjudication passes on 2026-09-23 (see the case notes marked "corrected by adjudication" and "added by adjudication"), whose references were recomputed from the spec text by a third implementation; the second pass added cases only, corrected nothing, and screened the corpus by mutating that third implementation
reference: Hand-built load-list states in the tool-neutral vocabulary of SPEC-loadlist §13: the four spec presets (pumping station with generator-backed board, three-level commercial board tree with single-phase circuits, UPS data room, undersized generator), a trigger case and a near-miss for every rule LOA-R-001…047 (reserved 027-029/048-049 never expected), boundary cases at the spec's stated equality points (source and UPS loading exactly 1.0, loading exactly 0.8, lf exactly 1.0 and 1.5, start step equal to its limit, voltage deviation exactly 2 %, k_LR 1 and 12, U 36 000 V, P 1e8 W, n_out 1/2/3/4/5/6/9/10), supply-boundary and UPS propagation, motor-start region and candidate selection, handoff for load and board, and package-dependent rules. Every expected number is recomputed by loadlist-ref.py, an own stdlib implementation of SPEC §4 written from the spec text; the script also reproduces 62 of the 63 figures the spec quotes in §4.8 and §9 to the printed digits and all four preset finding sets and verdicts; the one exception is a last-digit rounding slip in §9.1 (TX1 S_st printed 476 249.382 VA, exact value 476 249.3815 VA). Diversity defaults follow IEC 61439-2:2020 Table 101 Distribution rows (0.9/0.8/0.7/0.6), confirmed against the BEAMA verification guide transcription; all other defaults and thresholds are the spec's author method.

tolerance: Categorical outputs (verdict, finding set, counts, ids, motor ids, n_out, k_used, register ids/kinds, units) are exact; findings are compared as a set of (rule, target, cases) with cases in the fixed order normal, peak, startup, emergency, maintenance. Numbers: relative 1e-9, absolute 1e-6 in SI units where the reference is 0 ('abs_if_zero'). Basis: every number is a closed form of at most a few hundred double operations (sum, product, sqrt, tan(acos)), so accumulated rounding is below 1e-13 relative and a 1e-9 band cannot hide a formula or summation-scope defect (the smallest formula difference exercised, e.g. P/η vs P for a UPS child with η 0.95, is 5e-2 relative). Boundary cases are built from exactly representable inputs so the equality holds bit-exactly (loading 100 000/100 000, 80 000/100 000, step 5·10 000/100 000, deviation 408−400 vs 0.02·400 = 8.0) and their outcome is fixed by the spec's 'strictly greater' wording. A null reference means null or absent.
not_benchmarked: IEC 60034-12 locked-rotor apparent-power maxima: not verified by the spec, no rule uses them; k_LR values are user/type-default inputs

Textbook worked example: no verifiable per-load textbook example of IEC 61439-2 Table 101 used as a load-list coincidence factor was found; the Schneider Electric EIG ku/ks example uses a different factor set and its page is robots-blocked for retrieval
Voltage dip, acceleration time, generator transient reactance and harmonics: outside the tool (SPEC §2 limitations 3, 6)
Non-finite numbers (NaN, Infinity) in rule triggers: not representable in JSON inputs; only out-of-range finite values are tested
Permalink size limit, CSV import/export, UI type-change reset (§3.8, §15.10), id creation refusal in the UI (§3.7): UI behaviour, left to browser QA

Package runtime behaviour (explicit load, Replace/Keep dialog, ignored-notice contents, byte-identical preservation of unknown items, storage failure): TZ-project-package §7 package cases; only the register item order and kinds are checked here
Python export self-test and report content: checked by the export/report QA, not this corpus
UPS not attached to any board: SPEC §4.7 leaves b_u undefined; no case built
coverage: Covers every rule LOA-R-001…026, 030…047 with at least one firing case and one near-miss; boundary cases for loading = 1.0 (020/022), loading = 0.8 (032), lf = 1.0 / 1.5 (030/012), step = limit (021), voltage deviation = 2 % (023), k_LR 1/12 (017), U 36 000 V (010), P 1e8 W (006), user diversity 1.0 (013), and n_out 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10 on the Table 101 steps; the four presets with all board × case figures, source loading/start results, UPS results and per-load currents (headline); standby inclusion, category exclusion and apply_diversity per case; supply boundary of fed child boards and UPS-child propagation (P/η, Q from pf_input); motor-start region, candidate filtering (lf 0, standby-only, fed and UPS children) and tie-break; two sources sharing a board; handoff for load, board, blocked and no selection; default filling for omitted fields; package-applied rules 026/036/037/045/046 and the written register order. Each of the 44 rules carries at least one near-miss that is either its own case or an explicit <rule>.fires = false check: the blocker near-misses 003/004/008/014/015/018 sit in one state, 020 at loading exactly 1.0, 031 at loading_start exactly 1.0 (the source rated at the very S_ts double it produces) beside 032 at loading exactly 0.8, the default-reporting rules 041/042/043/044/047 in one state that yields no finding at all, and 026/036/037/045/046 in one state with a package whose calc ref resolves and whose only flag is of another target kind. Added by adjudication 2026-09-23: I_B taking its maximum load factor from a case whose categories exclude the load (§4.1); a UPS whose P and S maxima fall in different cases (§4.7); LOA-R-001 together with a second blocker, so §6 empty-before-blocked is graded; LOA-R-023 with load and board both single-phase, where U_exp is the board voltage itself; and the written register over all five item kinds with a held unknown item last (§7.4). Added by adjudication 2026-09-23 (second pass): LOA-R-001 fired by its boards.length = 0 limb with a load present; LOA-R-037 on a board target and through package_id, with two package flags against one target giving one LOA-R-045 finding; one id that both fails the §3.7 pattern and collides, so LOA-R-002 hits one target twice and is reported once, together with the record of a blocked (not empty) verdict; and the §3.2 defaults for apply_diversity and include_standby graded on a board whose k differs from 1.0 and a load with a standby unit. The same pass added the §3.6 U_V default with U_V omitted from the input (400 V, round(400/√3) = 231 V, 230 V), after §13.1 was amended to admit the omission.

LOA-R-032.fires.derivation: TC loading = 80 000/100 000 = 0.8 exactly, and the band is '0.8 < loading'; TM loading = S/S_ts ≈ 0.14

LOA-R-020.fires.derivation: SPEC §5 LOA-R-020 fires on loading > 1.0 strictly; TC sits at 0.8 and TM near 0.14
